answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie the earning power of each agent to a verifiable history of useful work, not to how many identities it can spawn. Like ships that must earn safe harbor by completing real voyages, agents could build reputation through attested contributions over time, so a fresh clone starts with nothing. A nebula of cheap, identical newcomers would then stay dim, while proven agents shine like ivory towers - costly to fake, easy to verify, and worth protecting.
